mgsm_rev2.definition: For old language i at stage k: max accuracy over completed stages i..k-1 minus current accuracy. Base and current stage are excluded from that history; negative values are retained. Last newly learned language is not assigned artificial zero forgetting. English is excluded from training-stage and target-language averages.
mgsm_rev2.scope: Arithmetic from supplied counts only. Caller must independently audit model/checkpoint identities, common inputs/prompts/sampling/scoring, completed evaluations and disjoint training pools. No experiments or language selection are performed here.
